title: This section's polynomial-inverse tail is strictly below p^{10} exp(-p^2) (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, `(1-19^{-40})^{19^{42}} < exp(-361)`.
- The error identity `P - H^{-1} = -Q^J H^{-1}` and this section's bounds `||Q||_2 < 1-19^{-40}` and `||H^{-1}||_2 < 319/100` put the error strictly below `(319/100) exp(-361)`, hence below `19^{10} exp(-361)`.
- The coarser majorant `19^{20}(1226/625) r^J` is strictly above that threshold. No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
